extent:
A DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE, NOT A RECORD OF CANON LAW.

It exists so the page that reads this shape could be written and checked before
the act-history lane's real slice arrived, and the release does not publish it.
Four acts, seven canons in twelve paragraphs and five divisions: enough to
exercise every state the page can be asked to draw, and nothing like a Code.

It claims nothing about any canon's words. The 1917 canons carry no text because
nobody here read them; the 1983 canons carry their words withheld, because the
Latin typical text of the 1983 Code is a work of the Holy See later than 1929
and this project holds no licence for it. Those two silences are different and
the page prints them differently. Where the words are withheld, what this record
can still say is which act established the text now in force.

It maps NO canon of either Code onto the other. The 1917 and 1983 numberings do
not correspond, and the correspondence between them is a scholarly claim; this
fixture carries none, so the page says so rather than implying one.

Its one interpretation row is a placeholder that quotes no responsum.

lines.label: The Pio-Benedictine Code (1917)
lines.note: The first codification, in force from 19 May 1918 until the Code of 1983 took effect. It is a line of its own and joins nothing below it.

lines.label: The Code of 1983
lines.note: The Code now in force for the Latin Church, with the acts that have amended it. It begins at its own promulgation and descends from nothing in this record.

stations.citation: Benedict XV, Providentissima Mater Ecclesia, 27 May 1917, recorded at src/sources/works/catholic-church/codex-iuris-canonici-1917/work.toml; the Code bound from 19 May 1918.
stations.effect: Establishes the state this fixture treats as the base of the 1917 line.
stations.title: Providentissima Mater Ecclesia promulgates the Pio-Benedictine Code

stations.citation: John Paul II, Sacrae disciplinae leges, 25 January 1983, recorded at src/sources/works/john-paul-ii/sacrae-disciplinae-leges/work.toml; in force from the first day of Advent 1983 (27 November 1983).
stations.effect: Establishes the state this fixture treats as the base of the 1983 line.
stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code of 1983

stations.citation: Francis, Mitis Iudex Dominus Iesus, 15 August 2015. This project holds no source record for the instrument; the act stands here on its being universally reported, and the reading has not been done.
stations.effect: Substitutes the canons governing the process for declaring nullity of marriage.
stations.instrument: Apostolic letter motu proprio Mitis Iudex Dominus Iesus
stations.title: Mitis Iudex Dominus Iesus reforms the process for declaring nullity of marriage

stations.citation: Francis, Pascite gregem Dei, 23 May 2021, recorded at src/sources/works/francis/pascite-gregem-dei/work.toml; promulgated by publication in L'Osservatore Romano and in force from 8 December 2021.
stations.effect: Replaces the whole of Book VI, the penal law.
stations.title: Pascite gregem Dei promulgates the revised Book VI
